subject: Great product
review: Love this website. The vinyl is excellent quality. Love it is pvc free too. The customer service is top quality too. Can't fault this site.

subject: Great Guitar!
review: This is an excellent guitar.  It has all the bells and whistles and great tone.

subject: The Ultimate Shredder
review: If you've been waiting for your ultimate guitar, this SG is the one for you.  I've had mine for a few weeks now and my playing has increased substantially as a result of the thin profile and great controls.  I definitely recommend checking this one out.

subject: Great guitar!!!!!!
review: Highly recommend these guys to anyone looking for a new electric!  Fast service, obviously classic guitar.

subject: My new baby.
review: If it's possible to love an inanimate object, I've found mine.  I was told that these guitars were hard to play because the strings were set so high.  No worries...this thing rocks!  Don't listen to the haters, I simply love this guitar.

subject: Nice but pricey!
review: This is a nice guitar.  I was probably hoping for a little more than nice for the price, but I'm working it into my rig.  Ask me in a year.

subject: Still Screaming!
review: I wish I had held on to my first one.  I sold it a few years back.  Even though it's starting to look it's age, I still love the action.

subject: A Classic
review: I LOVE THIS GUITAR!

subject: I believe...
review: Had a fellow bandmate recommend this years ago...now I know why.  Great sound and I've never had a guitar so easy to play.  I love it.  I wish it would have been boxed a little better.  When the guy dropped it off, I was sure it would be scratched...luckily, it made it through.

subject: Warm Pie.
review: I've wanted this guitar since I read about it a few years ago.  I save my pennies and finally saw delivery a few weeks ago.  It's everything I hoped for.  But the girl on the phone was nasty.  Don't know who spoiled her day....Sarah...but she certainly tried to take it out on me!

subject: A Sweet Ride
review: Love it!

subject: Bad shipper, great guitar.
review: This was a straight 5 star review..except for our shipper.  For some reason, this genius decided it was okay to leave my guitar between my doors.  It ended up getting stolen.  But this vendor was great at helping me secure a second unit.  I hope the guy that stole it from me gets hit by a truck.  Guitar is...as expected...very cool.

subject: Dreadful!
review: I was so disappointed in this whole experience.  First, let me say that this guitar is great and the vendor bent over backwards to help me.  But the shipping company just made my life a nightmare.  Lost my first shipment, damaged my second one...I'm now waiting for guitar #3.
reviewcons: Next time, I'll pick it up at the store.

subject: There's only one way to rock!
review: Not your dad's guitar.  Unless your dad is a rock star.  This cool new axe makes it fun to play again.  I love it.

subject: From the box to the stage
review: This is one nice acoustic. I played this on stage the day it arrived.  It would have been a complete 5 star experience...save the case.  I'm a stickler for quality cases and for the price, the case on this guitar just doesn't match.  I'll be upgrading my case in the next few weeks.  Buy the guitar, buy the case someplace else.

subject: Not thrilled
review: When I spend big bucks on a guitar, I'd like to finish playing it with a little drool on my chin.  In this case, I just didn't feel it.  I guess it's an okay guitar, but I'm not thrilled with the action, strings seem a little high and the overall quality of the sound left me wanting more.  Hoping I'll get used to it and feel bad that I wrote this.

subject: A solid choice!!!
review: I love this guitar.  It had everything I wanted...it was good looking, plays really nice and sounds great!

subject: A New Member Of The Family!
review: I fell in love when I saw this guitar a few years ago.   I finally consummated the deal last week.  No regrets.  Sounds great, plays great, looks great.  Overall...you guessed it...GREAT!

subject: A Great Purchase!
review: Purchased this 2 weeks ago...don't know how I lived with out it for so long.  Great tone on my rock settings, but a very nice response for the acoustic stuff!

subject: Disappointing
review: I'm sure that if I had purchased this for rock shows, I'd have written a different review.  But I mostly use my amp to boost my acoustic ensemble and this just has too much of an edge for me.  I'll be returning it soon.

subject: Dangerous Weapon
review: My new adopted amp of choice.  Really bought this as a backup to my existing Twin setup.  But within 2 days, it was front and center with my Twin relegated to the bench.  Don't let the tweed suit fool you...this guy brings serious dirt.

subject: Great experience!
review: These guys were awesome.  I had an issue with my first purchase and they sent a replacement while I was still on the phone with customer service.  The return was free and I turned the whole process around in a few days.  The amp is now performing fine, but I was a little disappointed with the response of the unit.  For the price, I thought the knobs would be a little less cheesy...I ended up replacing them about 2 weeks in.  Otherwise, the sound is great!

subject: Great Amp
review: Great amp at a great price.  The tweed was a bit shoddy where it was glued together, hence the 4 star rating for quality.  This amp rocks, though.  Smooth sounds of the old days echo from it's speaker.  A must have for any retro guitar rocker.
reviewpros: Great Looking, Great Price, Awesome Sound

subject: Orange you glad you bought this?
review: Bad pun, but great amp.  Used it on stage 2 days after I purchased it.  Immediately made the overall quality of my sound go up.  I'd recommend this to anyone that wants one versatile piece of equipment.

subject: A giant leap in quality.
review: Wow...I didn't realize how crappy my rig was until I put this in front of it.  Worth every penny.

subject: Tubes Rule!
review: The amp was great...nothing beats a tube amp.  I was a little bummed by the service.  After I ordered, I found out that the item was out of stock.  I waited almost 2 weeks and then it just showed up...no email, no message, nothing.  I would have liked a little better communication from the vendor.  I'm over it now and the amp sounds great!

subject: Good Times...
review: I was looking for a second stage amp to handle the grungy stuff.  I found it.

subject: Cool second unit!
review: Purchased as a second amp to keep at home while my rig is on the truck.  Can't complain...it's been everything I hoped for.  Service from vendor was fast.

subject: Returning
review: This was not what I thought it would be.  I thought the top end was a little to tinny for my ears and the rumbling on the low end was annoying.  Oh well...live and learn.  I'm boxing it back up as we speak.

subject: Works as advertised...
review: Nice addition to my FX.  Right price and right features.  Highly recommend.

subject: No wait for this delay!
review: Got this quickly and it just works.  For the price, it's great!
reviewpros: The effect is wide and beefy.
reviewcons: Wish it were a little more heavy duty.

subject: The Candyman Can...
review: I buy effects pedals like other girls by shoes.  I'm going to try some other effects from these guys because this really seems like a good value.  I rather the overall experience lower because my order was late and calls to the vendor went unanswered.  A happy girl now.

subject: No complaints
review: Happy with the unit.  Thanks.

subject: Not bad!
review: I thought I might be wasting my money when I bought this.  Seemed a little cheap to do the trick, but I didn't have the funds for a step up.  Turned out...this is a nice value and I've been using it for a few weeks now.  Seems to hold up on the road and still sounds good.  I'd buy more from these guys.

subject: Sorry, can't hear you, my ears are bleeding!
review: But that's a good thing.  I can't get enough distortion...But this helps.

subject: Now I get it!
review: Wasn't really sure how this would affect my overall sound.  But this is so nice when I switch settings...it really keeps the crosstalk to a minimum.  Well worth 100 bucks!

subject: A Lifesaver!
review: I replaced my old multi-effects unit with a newer, cheaper brand, and didn't discover until the warranty ran out that this unit didn't have a built-in tuner.  But this helped me ease into the new system...does a great job.

subject: Bad investment
review: This unit didn't work with my setup.  It was hard to see under lights and not fine enough for my tastes.

subject: Not for me
review: Guess I should have read with more detail.  I thought that this unit would have onboard memory and I'd be able to store presets here, but this really is only the pedal board.  Probably my fault, but it's going back.

subject: Sweet deal.
review: This was a fun process.  I loved stepping through each phase of this to select a signature rig.  My record label gave me a gold card and told me to knock myself out.  I sure did.  Wish I could do this every day.  My order arrived in great shape and seemingly overnight...though I only paid for standard shipping.  A great experience.
